backgrounds: a coastal fishing town that no longer appears on maps
a soot-black industrial city of chimneys and canals
a mountain village that buried more people than it fed
a capital of streetcars, embassies, and rumors
a farming province flattened by the last war
a port city where every language was spoken badly
a company town owned entirely by the mine
a border region that changed countries four times
a river barge family that never stayed anywhere
a university quarter of cold rooms and long arguments
appearances: gaunt, with ink-stained cuffs and a borrowed coat
broad-shouldered, with a boxer's bent nose
small and quick, with eyes that count exits
elegant once, the clothes now a size too loose
weathered brown by outdoor work, scarred knuckles
pale as paper, with a habit of touching doorframes
wrapped in a greatcoat two wars out of date
young-faced but grey at the temples
heavyset and slow-moving, with careful gentle hands
tall and stooped, as if apologizing for it
